Requirement: Submit XML sitemap and keep separate sitemaps for guides, features, industries, tools
Notes: Use lastmod only when pages materially change.

Requirement: Ensure important pages are indexable and no accidental noindex on landing pages
Use stable, short, lowercase hyphenated URLs
Notes: Do not change URLs after indexing without redirects.

Requirement: Self-canonical on unique pages; canonical near-duplicate pSEO pages carefully
Notes: Avoid canonicalizing all city pages to one parent if they are meant to rank.

Requirement: Add SoftwareApplication, Service, HowTo, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList where relevant
Notes: Validate in Rich Results Test where applicable.

Requirement: Every new page should have 5–12 contextual internal links
Keep landing pages lightweight; compress screenshots; lazy-load below-fold media
Notes: SEO pages should not be bloated by heavy app JS.

Requirement: Ensure content is server-rendered or pre-rendered
Notes: Avoid Google needing client-side JS for primary content.

Requirement: Track audit CTA, demo CTA, WhatsApp click, pricing view, tool usage, signup
Notes: Needed to connect SEO to leads, not just traffic.

Requirement: Create page-type filters in Search Console: /guides/, /features/, /industries/, /tools/
No pSEO page should launch without unique intro, unique examples, and internal links
Use descriptive file names and alt text for screenshots and GBP examples
Notes: Capture image search and improve accessibility.

Requirement: Refresh high-traffic GBP guides every 60–90 days
Support/contact pages must state Pinzo is not Google and link to official support
